text_block_list.text:
Wah...! So many...!
You're really good at this...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them is so cute...
I'll line them up next to my favorite book... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, with this many,
I could put some on my bed too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I will cherish it with all my heart.
Thank you so much, Trainer!"
